title: Semio Rs New Architecture
description: Rebuild semio/rs/lib.rs as a clean greenfield skeleton matching semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql: one struct per GraphQL type with a main impl + an #[Object] impl, all pub fn async, a single global emit_event, and a parent/child web-worker topology where the parent routes Query.wip and Query.authoritative to two child workers. Wire one end-to-end operation (CreatedFixedPiece) through the full path as the reference flow.
summary:
Greenfield rewrite of semio/rs/lib.rs as a clean architecture matching semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql.

What shipped:
- Hierarchical region tree: id, timestamp, error, geom, meta, hash, kit (type/design/piece/connection), vcs (change/transaction/draft/checkpoint/alternative/graph/session/conflict), op, event, worker, gql, wasm_bridge.
- One struct per GraphQL type, named exactly as the schema type, with a main impl (all pub fn async) plus an #[Object]/#[Subscription] impl. No struct named *Store.
- Single emit point: event::EventBus::emit_event(&self, ev: KitEvent) is the only emit_event in the crate; guard test asserts uniqueness.
- Worker topology (parent router): worker::ParentRuntime spawns two ChildRuntimes (wip + authoritative) that each own an Arc<RwLock<Graph>>, with async-channel inbound work queues and an async-broadcast outbound bus. Native: in-process std::thread + futures-lite. wasm32: spawn_local with a wasm_bridge entry point (parent_boot, schema_sdl).
- End-to-end op: createFixedPiece is fully wired: Mutation -> ParentRuntime::dispatch_wip -> Command::CreateFixedPiece -> ChildRuntime::apply -> Graph::apply_create_fixed_piece -> Piece insert -> EventBus::emit_event(KitEvent::CreatedFixedPiece) -> Subscription createdFixedPiece. Other operations (fixPiece, renameKit, changeDescription) are stubs that emit only commandSucceeded.
- Tests (in-file): parses_target_schema, single_emit_event_in_codebase (text-scan guard), create_fixed_piece_end_to_end, wip_and_authoritative_are_isolated. All 4 pass on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc; cargo check passes on wasm32-unknown-unknown.

Out of scope (deferred to follow-up tickets): porting change-commands, diff merge, flatten algorithm, kit hash, full VCS persistence, backbone (dev/local/remote) and conflict resolution from lib.old.rs onto this new skeleton; full wasm postMessage routing for the parent router.
